name: mattiasgronlund-local
description: Shared Claude Code tooling for the rcad and rscene repos, kept in one place because a copy in each is a copy that goes stale.

plugins.name: questions
plugins.description: Open questions for the user: one parser, a grammar that can be checked, the status line that reads it, and the skill that says how to write one.

plugins.name: guardrails
plugins.description: The two hooks that hold a rule the prose cannot: no in-place shell patching of tracked files, and a context budget that asks for a handoff.

plugins.name: practices
plugins.description: The shared working skills: how to delegate, grill, hand off, test, audit a claim, and read a numerical refusal.
